name: IC Interface — SPI — SOIC
description: Surface-mount SPI interface ICs in SOIC packaging featuring Tier-A KiCad symbol entries using the SOIC-28W_7.5x17.9mm_P1.27mm footprint.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a surface-mount SPI interface IC in a SOIC package.
Choose for board layouts targeting the SOIC-28W_7.5x17.9mm_P1.27mm land pattern.
Use when selecting Tier-A interface symbol entries such as MCP23S17x-x-SO or MCP23S18x-x-SO.
avoid_when: Do not use if the design requires an interface communication protocol other than SPI.
Avoid when a surface-mount SOIC package footprint is not suitable.
Avoid if non-SOIC or through-hole component packages are required.
